TOOL: wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(infile)
ws=wb['Sheet1']
for r in range(1, ws.max_row+1):
    if ws[f'F{r}'].value=='Marble Slab Creamery':
        j=ws[f'J{r}'].value
        if isinstance(j,(int,float)) and float(j).is_integer():
